subject: Buy path matrix: owners, contract lanes, and redline cadence
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Buy path matrix: owners, contract lanes, and redline cadence

Team — quick post-call recap from today’s discovery with MediSight and proposed next steps so we keep legal/procurement moving without a last-minute scramble. Notes below are action-oriented; I flagged owners where I think we should drive.

Call summary (30 min):
- Customer: MediSight Health (pilot: image-annotation summarization)
- Decision criteria they emphasized: PHI handling, latency SLA (<200ms p50 for inference), predictable cost for 5k reqs/day, proven data deletion/retention controls.
- Timeline: evaluation in August; procurement target week of Aug 4.

Stakeholder map (names they confirmed):
- Economic buyer: Elaine Wu (Head of Digital Ops) — final signoff on spend and risk
- Procurement lead: Tom Reyes (procurement@medsight.com) — purchase order and legal routing
- Legal reviewer: external counsel (they’ll route to their GC depending on redlines)
- Security reviewer: Claire Ng (infosec) — wants SOC2 + DPA specifics

Contract routing & desired cadence (customer request):
1) NDA — already requested; Elaine can sign quickly. Customer asked for executed NDA within 3 business days.
2) MSA — they want to review our standard MSA with redline capability. Their preference is to get a first redline back from Redwood within 5 business days of receiving our draft.
3) DPA — security wants a data addendum that lists subprocessors and retention policy; they asked for a separate DPA or inline exhibit.

Proposed Redwood owner map:
- Send NDA and receipt: Ben (primary) — Ben to attach standard NDA (we have one pre-approved for sales) and track return.
- MSA & redlines: Olga (contract coordinator) + Legal (we'll pull in Legal once initial redlines are done) — target turnaround: 5 business days for first technical redline; subsequent cycles TBD but aim for 2 business days per cycle for small changes.
- Security evidence & DPA draft: Jasmine (security liaison) — provide SOC2 summary and DPA draft; coordinate Claire’s questions.

Immediate asks:
- Ben: send NDA today and confirm MediSight signing ETA.
- Jasmine: package SOC2 executive summary + standard DPA draft and mark any non-negotiables.
- Karthik: prepare a 1-page buyer-facing risk/cost summary for Elaine focused on latency and unit economics.

Attachments to send with NDA packet: SOC2_report_short.pdf (exec summary), redwood_standard_nda_v2.docx (sales copy). I’ve attached a copy of the MSA we expect to send once NDA is executed.

I’ll follow up with an internal sync after we get the signed NDA.

Olga Petrov
Enterprise Account Director | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Buy path matrix: owners, contract lanes, and redline cadence

Got it — thanks for the clear notes, Olga. I’ll send the NDA packet to Elaine and Tom right after this and request signature within 3 business days (per their ask). I’ll include the SOC2 exec summary; Jasmine, can you confirm the latest SOC2 doc I should attach?

Two quick clarifications from the call:
- Elaine asked whether we can carve latency SLA into the SOW rather than the MSA. If Legal pushes back we'll need a brief SOW template ready.
- Procurement asked whether we accept PO or require a signed MSA first. Tom indicated PO is fine if MSA redlines are in progress.

Plan: NDA out today; flag MSA kickoff to Olga once NDA confirmed. I’ll copy procurement@medsight.com and attach MediSight_MSA_v1_redlines.pdf as the starting document for their counsel to review.

Ben
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
[Attachment: MediSight_MSA_v1_redlines.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Buy path matrix: owners, contract lanes, and redline cadence

Thanks — attaching the SOC2 executive summary we usually share. A few notes for coordination with Claire Ng (their security lead):
- The DPA template we send should include subprocessors list; our current list is up-to-date but I recommend we highlight the KMS/HSM options and the data retention default (30 days for cache, 90 days logs) and where we can tighten by request.
- If they require a Data Processing Addendum as a standalone doc, we can provide that in parallel with the MSA redline. That should not delay signature on the MSA itself; legal typically tolerates a DPA follow-up.
- I will also prepare a short answers sheet for Claire on PHI handling and encryption-at-rest/in-transit.

Jasmine Liu
Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
[Attachment: SOC2_report_short.pdf (pdf), redwood_dpa_template.docx (docx)]

From: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@medsight.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@medsight.com>, procurement@medsight.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Buy path matrix: owners, contract lanes, and redline cadence

Thanks for the recap. Quick confirmations from our side:
- NDA: Elaine will sign and return within 48 hours.
- Procurement: Tom is our PO contact; he confirms a PO is acceptable to start purchases while MSA redlines are negotiated, but final approval requires GC review if redlines are material.
- Timeline note: Tom asked if Redwood can commit to returning an initial MSA redline within 2 business days instead of 5 — they have a tight internal procurement window. If 2 days is untenable, please advise so we can adjust our schedule.

Also looping in our Security lead Claire Ng (cc’d on a subsequent thread) and external counsel if/when they want the MSA.

Elaine Wu
Head of Digital Operations | MediSight Health
elaine.wu@medsight.com | +1 617-555-0202
[Attachment: MediSight_NDA_signed.pdf (pdf)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@medsight.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@medsight.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Buy path matrix: owners, contract lanes, and redline cadence

Perfect — Elaine, appreciate the quick turn on the NDA. Team, updated plan based on Tom’s ask:
- Ben: send the MSA early today with a note that we’ll aim to return an initial redline within 2 business days. If legal needs additional runway, we’ll flag immediately, but let’s try to meet the 2-day ask.
- Jasmine: prioritize the DPA and the Claire answers sheet so we can send those in parallel.
- Karthik: please draft the risk/cost one-pager and I’ll attach it to the MSA email to Elaine and Tom.

Operational notes for legal routing:
- Sequence: NDA (executed) -> MSA (first technical redline from Redwood) -> GC review cycle -> Final MSA execution -> DPA finalization (ok to sign concurrently if both counsel agree).
- Turn-time SLAs (internal target): NDA: 3 business days external; MSA first redline: 2 business days; subsequent redline cycles: 48 hours for minor items / up to 5 business days for material revisions.

I’ll open a HubSpot task and attach all docs so Legal can jump in. Ben, tag me when you send the MSA so I can track QC.

Olga
Enterprise Account Director | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
[Related HubSpot task: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-7391/tasks]
